spanish: Y apoyará su mano sobre cabeza del pecado, y la degollará a pecado en lugar que se degüella el holocausto.

findings.issue: Qal imperfect 3ms active, with את marking הָעֹלָה as object. Spanish se-passive makes the burnt offering the subject and drops the 3ms agent.

notes: Weqatal futures, singular hand, 3fs la, and definite then indefinite pecado match the other tokens.
